items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I'd like to ask Lawrence Morrero. He knows.

ctx.x: And now that I'm going to put a letter from him and I see how he scratched his name down there. I'm like a business man. I said, wow, he went to win at school. He writes nice. I've seen him write.
I'm sorry to put the wall back there. Is he still back in that street? I don't know. I'd like to ask Lawrence Morrero. He knows.
Don't forget to get these. I think I have it written down at Tulane. I'm trying to save all that stuff.
